head: b88102f8ed9a46d02b4ed532a2e2283f96edb6e1
findings: Both infra audit and test reach test:lambda; its leading cd changes the package manifest used by subsequent bun run invocations.
The nested manifest defines typecheck, bundle:check and zip:check; these are not absent scripts.
The chain performs frozen-lockfile install, TypeScript noEmit validation, Bun tests, esbuild bundling and handler-export loading, then ZIP assembly. It was not executed by this review.

bundle:check removes the nested build directory, bundles three entries targeting Node22 CommonJS and executes a Node smoke script that loads each module and checks handler export type. This is not handler behavior or remote conformance proof.

zip:check removes a fixed turbo-cache-zip-check directory under TMPDIR (or /tmp) and calls package-zip.sh. The shell script copies three outputs, normalizes timestamps through touch, creates ZIP with zip -X, checks size exceeds one million bytes, and prints path, size and SHA256. Tool versions, timezone semantics, TMPDIR, filesystem state and concurrent use of the fixed location require explicit consideration.

The current census enables cache for infra#test with empty outputs; infra#audit disables cache. The ledger has no explicit infra#test tuple entry. Writes alone do not prove cached test verdicts unsafe: output consumption and runtime input coverage require investigation before a policy transition.

nestedScripts.bundle:check: rm -rf build && bunx esbuild src/index.ts src/authorizer.ts src/writer.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outdir=build --entry-names='[name]' --out-extension:.js=.cjs --alias:punycode=punycode/ --log-level=warning && node test/bundle-smoke.cjs build

limits: No install, bundle load, archive creation, cloud call or deployment executed.
No runtime safety, determinism, signed-remote or conformance claim.
Standalone Lambda source, nested lock/toolchain, test dependencies and archive consumers remain incomplete review obligations.
All existing unresolved obligations and qualification lifecycle remain unchanged.
